name: bundled-requirement-decomposition
body: The brief bundles two requirements. The coordinator-removal concern is one atomic requirement. The reviewer-distribution concern is the distribution requirement plus the distinct migration requirement `requirements.requirement.reviewer-upgrade-removal-guide`, whose manual-removal instruction is separately testable user-facing behaviour (`APG_UPGRADE_DOC` plus the `upgrade_doc_covers_version_field_gate_and_fix_steps` needle). The migration requirement is parented under `requirements.user.apg-upgrader` rather than under the distribution requirement, so the `contains` hierarchy stays a tree.
